takeaways: Microsoft Entra External ID is Microsoft's CIAM service for customers, partners and guests and replaces Azure AD B2C, swapping XML custom policies for user flows and custom authentication extensions.

It covers customer sign-up (B2C), partner collaboration (B2B) and machine-to-machine scenarios, and customer-facing apps should usually run in a separate external tenant rather than the workforce tenant.
B2C stays supported until at least 2030 but gets no new features, so new projects should start on External ID and existing B2C tenants should plan a step-by-step migration.
hook: Building sign-up, sign-in and security for customer-facing apps is hard, and Azure AD B2C is no longer where Microsoft invests. This episode helps identity admins and developers understand Microsoft Entra External ID, pick the right tenant model, secure external users and plan the move away from B2C.
